svg.aria-label: BPMN collaboration. The stakeholder sends a business need. The business analyst elicits, analyzes, specifies and validates; a gateway checks sign-off and loops back to analyze if not approved; then dev and QA build and test, with a defect loop. A traceability chain links business need, business rule, use case, user story and test case.
svg.title: How I turn a vague need into a traced spec
svg.text: HOW I TURN A VAGUE NEED INTO A TRACED SPEC
BPMN COLLABORATION · BA LIFECYCLE · ONE REQUIREMENT, END TO END
business owner · end users · process owners
example IDs · every requirement keeps its ID from need to test
